item.tib: mdo sde dam pa yid bzhin nor bu las klu chog zhi bde legs tshogs gter char
item.coloph: ces pa'i mdo sde yid bzhin nor bu'i klu chog 'di nyid mkha' 'gro bde chen dbang mos g.yu mtsho nas gter du drangs shing/ slar khyung dkar mthong grol ri khrod du grub dbang gong ma'i khri 'dzin kun dga' tshul rgyal sku mched dang / ri khrod mtshams pa rnam dag 'gyur med dang / mtshams pa thams cad kyis bskul ngor/ mkha' 'gro' bde chen dbang mo'i (mos) shog ser las zhal bshus te thog ma'i yi ge pa ni ri khrod dbu mdzad g.yung drung tshul khrims kyis bgyis pas zabagater rin po che'i smin grol mkha' ltar khyab par gyur cig/
